problems: Donbas treatment settled by the author: DPR and LPR lands are Russian solid from 2022-9 (russian-federation 2024 keyframe = 2013 outline plus those lands; ukraine 2024 keyframe = 1992 outline minus them); Crimea and the occupied south stay hatched occupation. The reviewer's rider 'draw Crimea the same way' was not applied (project scope draws Crimea as occupied land); a renderer wanting one rule can retype russian-federation's two September 2022 gains as occupation_start and drop the two union members of its 2024 keyframe.

russian-occupied-territories type finding (umbrella vs fold into russian-federation) was an orchestrator decision flagged 'does not block': kept as umbrella with documented, mirror-less gain and loss events; counted as addressed, not as a change. fixes_applied counts 18 of the 19 listed findings (russian-federation 7, ukraine 9 including the confidence change the reviewer had already applied, russian-occupied-territories 2). Partial: russian-federation /ledger/10 (buffer-zone events and W3 zones added; whether Abkhazia and South Ossetia are Russian-occupied is for the georgia owner).

Mirrors that other owners must write or change: georgia (eu-19) lacks Poti in its buffer-zone circles and an occupation mirror for Abkhazia and South Ossetia; chechen-republic (eu-19) has no 1995 loss; donetsk-people-s-republic (eu-22-x) should split Mariupol out of its June 2022 gain at May and its dissolve events assume Russian solid; czech-republic (eu-22-e) lacks the 1997 Slovak exchange mirrors; british-colonial hand-over for british-overseas-territories (verdict fix, not touched).
Place names missing from the gazetteer were written as lon/lat circles with the name in 'text'; swap for place names when the gazetteer agent adds them (gazetteer_names_needed).

New regions (north of Kyiv, east Kharkiv Oblast, Kherson right bank, Kursk) are circles cut to oblasts; the Kherson right bank (28 cells) and the north (23 cells) are readings of named towns at confidence 2, not outlines from a page.

events_total and sources_total are batch totals; serbia-montenegro, slovakia and british-overseas-territories are unchanged at their earlier counts. Remaining validator warnings are occupation_start/contest_start events still open at the end of the data (russian-federation 4, ukraine 2, russian-occupied-territories 0).
